gallery.source: Catherineberg Sugar Mill Ruins, interior view including column details; Saint John, United States Virgin Islands
gallery.description:
Interior view of Catherineberg Sugar Mill Ruins located in the Virgin Island National Park on Saint John, U.S. Virgin Islands. The ruins are an example of an 18th century sugar and rum factory. This view shows the support column and other architectural details. 
In the 1733 slave revolt, Catherineberg property was the headquarters of the Amina warriors.
